title: hwo-2005-national
label: The Butcher

won.source: The home page dates Scarred For Life to 17 July 2005 and says it crowned 'the new hWo National Champion'; the owner's review thread of 20 July congratulates the player of The Butcher on winning 'the National Champion'.

how: Won at the fed's first pay-per-view; the finish itself is not held.
note: The show's own results page is not held. The holder is inferred from the owner's congratulation to the player of The Butcher (who signs with a first name) and from The Butcher's billing against Payne Fosters in the show's main-event thread; the results page is not held.
